What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before answering who decided on the zero or whether Owen was heard first, and you never showed a single document, so the offer read as a deal for something unproven.
Try next time: When she asks who decided and whether Owen was spoken to first, answer that in one sentence, own that the zero went in before you called, and then show a dated document before you mention the rewrite.
